subtitle: Discord Companion
emptyDescription: Install a presence from the library.
connectionDescription: Manage the connection between the extension, the native companion, and Discord.
marketplaceDescription: Install, update, or remove your presences from the Nowly library.
languageDescription: Use your browser's language by default, or choose a specific language for Nowly.
onboardingSubtitle: A quick guided setup to let Nowly communicate with Discord.
onboardingNonBlocking: You can continue using the panel while completing the setup.
onboardingStep1Body: Nowly uses a small native application to connect the extension to Discord RPC. It runs in the background and only receives the presence data required to update your activity. No personal data is collected.
onboardingStep2Body: Install and launch the native companion, keep Discord running, then connect. Once Discord is detected, your profile will appear here.
onboardingDiscordWaiting: Waiting for a Discord connection (make sure Discord is running).
onboardingStep3Body: Presences are installed and managed through the library. Each presence adds a detector for a supported website and can be enabled or removed at any time.
onboardingUserScriptsBody: Nowly installs presences using user scripts. This is a sensitive permission because it allows code to run on the websites you visit. To reduce risk, presences are digitally signed and verified locally before installation, and only the minimum activity data required is sent to the native companion to update your Discord status. Enable “Allow User Scripts” only if you understand and accept how this works.
onboardingUserScriptsHow: To enable it, open your browser's extensions page, select Nowly, and enable the “Allow User Scripts” option.
displayDescription: Choose how presences are organized in the list.
separateActiveDescription: Hides the active presence from the list.
showPlayerDescription: Displays the media player card at the top of the activity tab.
apiBaseUrlDescription: Override the default API URL for self-hosted instances.
onboardingUserScriptsGateBody: Nowly uses user scripts to run presences on supported websites. This is how the extension detects what you are watching or listening to, then prepares your Discord activity.
onboardingUserScriptsGatePrivacy: Installed presences are signed and verified locally before they run. Nowly does not store personal data for this step and only sends the minimum required information to the local client.
onboardingNativeGateBody: The client is a small local app that connects the extension to Discord Rich Presence. Without it, the browser cannot send your activity to Discord.
onboardingNativeGatePrivacy: The client only receives the activity information needed for Discord display. Nowly does not store your personal data for this connection.
onboardingNativeGateWait: Have you installed the client? Wait until this indicator turns blue to continue.
onboardingTourActivityBody: This area shows the presence currently detected and sent to Discord when everything is connected.
onboardingTourLibraryBody: Install new presences from the library, then come back here to manage them.
onboardingTourPresencesBody: Enable, disable, configure, or remove each installed presence from the list.
onboardingTourSettingsBody: Find language, display, updates, the native client, and diagnostics in settings.
analyticsDescription: Share anonymous technical stats to help improve presences, reliability, and install flows. Titles, URLs, searches, watched content, and Discord IDs are never sent.
onboardingAnalyticsHelp: Would you like to help us improve Nowly?
onboardingAnalyticsDelete: You can withdraw at any time.
dataManagementDescription: View and manage your data, analytics consent, and privacy settings.
snoozeDescription: Temporarily pause sending activity to Discord.
scheduleDescription: Set days and times when this presence can show on Discord.
scheduleFeatureDescription: Show schedule buttons on presences and in the action bar.
